# Devicon icon index

Generated by `scripts/build_icon_index.sh`. Do not edit by hand — edit
`scripts/fixtures/icon-index-tags-devicon.tsv` and regenerate.

Each row points at a usable PNG path. The Devicon set ships a curated
subset of ~150 popular dev-tool concepts at 48px in the `-original`
variant. Scope is defined by `scripts/fixtures/devicon-curation.txt`.

Find an icon by name, category, or tag:

```bash
grep -i 'python' dist/Devicon/INDEX.md          # by name
grep -F '`language`' dist/Devicon/INDEX.md      # by tag
grep -F '| database |' dist/Devicon/INDEX.md    # by category
```
